theorems.name: Submission.weighted_mono_kernel_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (ε σ ρ s : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → Antitone φ → (∀ t, t ≤ 1 → φ t = 1) → (∀ t, 1 + ε ≤ t → φ t = 0) → 0 < ε → 0 < σ → σ ≤ ρ → 0 < s → (φ (s / ρ) - φ (s / σ)) / s ^ n ≤ ∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, -(s / τ ^ 2) * deriv φ (s / τ) / τ ^ n ∧ ∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, -(s / τ ^ 2) * deriv φ (s / τ) / τ ^ n ≤ (1 + ε) ^ n * ((φ (s / ρ) - φ (s / σ)) / s ^ n)
